title: mimid-agent: take a newer did:webvh log without a restart
description: Since bead mimid-1wgh.4.81.18 the daemon reads [did_webvh].log_file only at start (Agent::open), and Agent::use_did_webvh_credential is the library API. A running daemon should notice the controller writing a newer log (or offer a local endpoint to hand it one) and offer it to its rooms. Also: when the Commit carrying it cannot be made (a pending GroupContextExtensions proposal, Open Issue 5), fall back to Member::propose_credential_update so another member commits it.
notes: Decided by Mark 2026-11-17: both. A local authenticated 'apply this log' endpoint on the agent (loopback, the agent's token) as the main path, plus watching [did_webvh].log_file; one shared check path; fall back to Member::propose_credential_update when the agent cannot commit (pending GCE, Open Issue 5).
close_reason: 207bdf4 (agent-core: Agent::use_did_webvh_credential is the one check-and-apply path, returns DidWebvhApplied; verifies, names this user, extends the current log, commits to every active room; fallback to Member::propose_credential_update when the Commit cannot be built; open skips an older log file) and c99ebb0 (daemon: POST /mimid/did-webvh/log behind the existing Host/CORS/token guard, INVENTED NOT FROM SPEC, documented in mimid-agent's didwebvh module and crate docs; watch of [did_webvh].log_file/witness_file by mtime+len then SHA-256 on the sync loop; both through apply_log). Tests: crates/mimid-agent/tests/didwebvh_log.rs (revocation POSTed while running removes d2 without restarts; unchanged; another user's log and the older v1 refused 422 with reason and not applied; 400 malformed; 401 without token; file change taken), crates/mimid-agent-core/src/agent_didwebvh_tests.rs (fallback through a real hub, Commit failure injected under cfg(test): proposal accepted, bob commits, record = controller's v2), mimi-mls didwebvh_rogue.rs (real pending GCE from a plain OpenMLS member -> PendingGroupContextExtensions, Update proposal still built). Limits found: with a real pending GCE a mimid committer of the Update fails too (Open Issue 5), and another member's revocation Remove needs canKick (filed as follow-up). Feedback item 28.
